question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 6.**
solution:
The correct answer is: also

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the proper use of these given conjunctions. 
 
 
• But is used for joining two ideas or statements when the second one is different from the first one.
 
• Also is used to add information to something we have already said and you need to place it in the sentence next to the thing or idea that you are adding.
 
• Whereas is used to indicate a contrast between two facts or ideas.
 
• Either is used when referring to a choice between two options.
 
 
 
• The implied meaning of the sentence is: "On vacations, avid wildlife photographers usually visit this location."
 
• As per the use of the given words, 'also' should be used.

Therefore, the correct answer is option 2.

Complete passage: *Finland is a country of vast green forests, beautiful Baltic islands, windswept Arctic mountains and (1) countless __blue lakes. These pristine and picturesque landscapes (2) __provide __a habitat for many wild animals and birds including (3) *__magnificent __*bears, wolves, eagles, cranes and swans, as well as (4) __the __world’s rarest seals. Birdwatchers flock to Finland to find (5) *__species __*that are hard to spot anywhere else in Europe. Keen wildlife photographers **__(6) also__** come here to enjoy excursions and facilities that enable (7) ________ to get spectacular shots of the amazing animals in their (8) _______ settings. Some of the great places to preserve these (9) ________ include Finland’s forty national parks, which are open to (10) _______ all year round.*
